templates.name: KeeneticOS by SNMP
templates.description:
KeeneticOS monitoring via SNMP. Collects ICMP/SNMP availability, system information, uptime, CPU load/utilization, memory usage and network interface traffic, status, errors and bandwidth utilization using SNMP walk, dependent items and LLD.

Used mib:
UCD-SNMP-MIB
SNMPv2-MIB

Author: Yaroslav Sharaev https://github.com/NicKerrr/zabbix-templates

triggers.expression: min(/KeeneticOS by SNMP/icmppingloss,5m)>{$ICMP_LOSS_WARN} and min(/KeeneticOS by SNMP/icmppingloss,5m)<100
triggers.name: KeeneticOS: High ICMP ping loss
KeeneticOS: High ICMP ping response time

dependencies.name: KeeneticOS: High ICMP ping loss
dependencies.expression: min(/KeeneticOS by SNMP/icmppingloss,5m)>{$ICMP_LOSS_WARN} and min(/KeeneticOS by SNMP/icmppingloss,5m)<100

items.name: KeeneticOS: CPU utilization
items.params:
100 * (
  change(//keenetic.cpu.raw.user)
  + change(//keenetic.cpu.raw.nice)
  + change(//keenetic.cpu.raw.system)
) / (
  change(//keenetic.cpu.raw.user)
  + change(//keenetic.cpu.raw.nice)
  + change(//keenetic.cpu.raw.system)
  + change(//keenetic.cpu.raw.idle)
)

triggers.expression: last(/KeeneticOS by SNMP/keenetic.system.description,#1)<>last(/KeeneticOS by SNMP/keenetic.system.description,#2) and length(last(/KeeneticOS by SNMP/keenetic.system.description))>0
triggers.name: KeeneticOS: Operating system description has changed

dependencies.name: KeeneticOS: System name has changed
dependencies.expression: last(/KeeneticOS by SNMP/keenetic.system.name,#1)<>last(/KeeneticOS by SNMP/keenetic.system.name,#2) and length(last(/KeeneticOS by SNMP/keenetic.system.name))>0

triggers.expression: last(/KeeneticOS by SNMP/keenetic.system.name,#1)<>last(/KeeneticOS by SNMP/keenetic.system.name,#2) and length(last(/KeeneticOS by SNMP/keenetic.system.name))>0
triggers.name: KeeneticOS: System name has changed
triggers.event_name: KeeneticOS: System name has changed (new name: {ITEM.VALUE})

triggers.expression: (last(/KeeneticOS by SNMP/keenetic.system.uptime)>0 and last(/KeeneticOS by SNMP/keenetic.system.uptime)<10m) or (last(/KeeneticOS by SNMP/keenetic.system.uptime)=0 and last(/KeeneticOS by SNMP/keenetic.system.uptime)<10m)
triggers.name: KeeneticOS: Host has been restarted

trigger_prototypes.expression:
(avg(/KeeneticOS by SNMP/net.if.in[{#SNMPINDEX}],15m)>({$IF.UTIL.MAX:"{#IFNAME}"}/100)*last(/KeeneticOS by SNMP/net.if.speed[{#SNMPINDEX}]) or
avg(/KeeneticOS by SNMP/net.if.out[{#SNMPINDEX}],15m)>({$IF.UTIL.MAX:"{#IFNAME}"}/100)*last(/KeeneticOS by SNMP/net.if.speed[{#SNMPINDEX}])) and
last(/KeeneticOS by SNMP/net.if.speed[{#SNMPINDEX}])>0
trigger_prototypes.recovery_expression:
avg(/KeeneticOS by SNMP/net.if.in[{#SNMPINDEX}],15m)<(({$IF.UTIL.MAX:"{#IFNAME}"}-3)/100)*last(/KeeneticOS by SNMP/net.if.speed[{#SNMPINDEX}]) and
avg(/KeeneticOS by SNMP/net.if.out[{#SNMPINDEX}],15m)<(({$IF.UTIL.MAX:"{#IFNAME}"}-3)/100)*last(/KeeneticOS by SNMP/net.if.speed[{#SNMPINDEX}])
trigger_prototypes.name: Interface {#IFNAME}({#IFALIAS}): High bandwidth usage

dependencies.name: Interface {#IFNAME}({#IFALIAS}): Link down
dependencies.expression:
last(/KeeneticOS by SNMP/net.if.status.oper[{#SNMPINDEX}])=2
and
last(/KeeneticOS by SNMP/net.if.status.admin[{#SNMPINDEX}])=1

dependencies.name: Interface {#IFNAME}({#IFALIAS}): Link down
dependencies.expression:
last(/KeeneticOS by SNMP/net.if.status.oper[{#SNMPINDEX}])=2
and
last(/KeeneticOS by SNMP/net.if.status.admin[{#SNMPINDEX}])=1

trigger_prototypes.expression:
last(/KeeneticOS by SNMP/net.if.status.oper[{#SNMPINDEX}])=2
and
last(/KeeneticOS by SNMP/net.if.status.admin[{#SNMPINDEX}])=1
trigger_prototypes.name: Interface {#IFNAME}({#IFALIAS}): Link down
